description: This file defines the Order model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically handling operations related to customer orders such as retrieving order details, order history, products, totals, and associated data.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents the customer order model, providing methods to retrieve and manipulate order data.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific order by order ID, including customer, shipping, and payment details.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders for the current customer, with optional start and limit for pagination.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns details of a specific product within an order based on order ID and order product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches all products related to a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options associated with a specific order product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Gets subscription details for a given order and product.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Returns vouchers linked to a specific order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Fetches total amounts associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history entries for a specific order, including status changes and comments.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history entries for an order.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProductId
methods.description: Get total number of orders involving a specific product ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByOrderId
methods.description: Get total number of products within a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTotalVouchersByOrderId
methods.description: Get total number of vouchers linked to a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Get total number of orders associated with a specific subscription ID for the current customer.
